svg.title: From a real contract PDF to H1-based sections with Ordo
svg.desc: Four panels: cropped Bonterms PDF, extracted untagged text, actual final 2B predictions, and deterministic section grouping. Excerpts are abbreviated. PDF extraction and grouping are outside the labeling model.

g.text: From plain text to document structure

ORDO / preserved final 2B predictions, not reviewed gold
